quests.title: ten past five at Capitol Square
quests.blurb: I am told you do odd jobs. I start at ten past five and for a month the Capitol Square back lane has had somebody in it who is not waiting for bread. There is probably a simple explanation and I would love to hear it. If anyone asks, you were never here.

steps.label: the lane, from the door, no flash
I am not calling anyone until I am sure

quests.title: The Lane Light, Capitol Square
quests.blurb: I'll be straight with you. A light on that lane costs Capitol Square $52 and the landlord has said no twice, so we are doing it ourselves. You will see what I mean the second you get there. There is no rush, but there is a Friday.

steps.label: $52 and I will fit it myself
do not tell him where it came from

quests.title: Flour Run, Capitol Square
quests.blurb: It has been three weeks. The flour for Capitol Square comes off a truck at ten past five and last a wet Monday the truck came and the flour did not. There is a version of this where I am the unreasonable one. I'll see you right for it.

steps.label: ride out to Chinatown where the load is made up
the pallet with our name on it, if it exists

quests.title: The Loading Zone, Capitol Square
quests.blurb: Nobody else has offered, so. The Capitol Square loading zone has had a car in it at ten past five every morning this week and the driver waits in it, which makes it worse. The paperwork says one thing and my eyes say another. I'll put the kettle on for when you're back.

steps.label: the one who says he is only a minute
and the ticket I got, off him

quests.title: The Sourdough Sign, Capitol Square
quests.blurb: The council knows and the council does not care. Somebody two doors down from Capitol Square put up a sign on a wet Monday that says the same six words as ours, in the same order. It has been going on longer than I have admitted to anyone. Just do not come back empty-handed.

steps.label: walk down and read it properly
both signs if you can get them in one frame
tell me I am not imagining it

quests.title: The Old Site, Capitol Square
quests.blurb: I have been putting it off since Easter. This business was at Convention before it was at Capitol Square, and there is a woman there who still has the original book. I have got no proof, which is exactly why I am asking. I will know if you skipped a bit.

steps.label: she is usually about in the afternoon
bring back whatever she is willing to say

quests.title: The Kingsgrove Pool
quests.blurb: I am told you do odd jobs. Council has been saying the Kingsgrove pool is at end of life since a wet Monday and the crack they keep pointing at is not in the shell. There is probably a simple explanation and I would love to hear it. If anyone asks, you were never here.

steps.label: the crack, close, with something for scale
an engineer can read that. A councillor cannot.

quests.title: The Petition Stall, Kingsgrove
quests.blurb: I'll be straight with you. We are running a stall for Kingsgrove on a wet Monday and a stall needs $108 of gear that nobody has volunteered to pay for. You will see what I mean the second you get there. There is no rush, but there is a Friday.

steps.label: $108 and a table, if you see one
I will be there from eight either way

quests.title: Squad, Kingsgrove
quests.blurb: It has been three weeks. I coach 52 kids at Kingsgrove at five in the morning and three of them have stopped coming without anybody ringing me. There is a version of this where I am the unreasonable one. I'll see you right for it.

steps.label: the flats where two of them live
take something with you, it is a long walk up
I do not need them back. I need to know.

quests.title: The Deep End, Kingsgrove
quests.blurb: Nobody else has offered, so. A group has been coming over the Kingsgrove fence after close and swimming in the dark, which is how Kingsgrove loses its pool. The paperwork says one thing and my eyes say another. I'll put the kettle on for when you're back.

steps.label: the ones who go over the fence
the spot in the fence they use

quests.title: The Kiosk Freezer, Kingsgrove
quests.blurb: The council knows and the council does not care. The kiosk at Kingsgrove has a chest freezer that hums in D in it and a freezer that has been running warm since a wet Monday. It has been going on longer than I have admitted to anyone. Just do not come back empty-handed.

steps.label: get two, we are going to be here
the plant room behind the kiosk
tell me whether it is the freezer or the power

quests.title: The Aquatic Centre, Kingsgrove
quests.blurb: I have been putting it off since Easter. They want everyone from Kingsgrove to drive to the new centre at Bexley North, so somebody should go and see whether it is any good. I have got no proof, which is exactly why I am asking. I will know if you skipped a bit.

steps.label: have a proper look, not a quick one
be honest with me, even if it is nice

quests.title: The Penrith Rank
quests.blurb: I am told you do odd jobs. The rank outside Penrith used to hold nine cars and since a Tuesday it holds four, and nobody will say who moved the line. There is probably a simple explanation and I would love to hear it. If anyone asks, you were never here.

steps.label: the painted line and the old one under it
the old paint is still there, that is the whole argument

quests.title: Lost Fares, Penrith
quests.blurb: I'll be straight with you. Since the rank at Penrith shrank I am $98 a week down, and the association wants that number from somebody who can prove it. You will see what I mean the second you get there. There is no rush, but there is a Friday.

steps.label: $98 in a week, to show it can be done
that is the submission, right there

quests.title: Queue Jumpers, Penrith
quests.blurb: It has been three weeks. Cars that have never sat in the Penrith queue turn up at the second express and take the front of it, and the drivers who waited say nothing. There is a version of this where I am the unreasonable one. I'll see you right for it.

steps.label: the ones who take the front
$67, which is about one airport run

quests.title: The Late Train, Penrith
quests.blurb: Nobody else has offered, so. When the last train into Penrith is late, 67 people come out at once and I have to have cars there before they do. The paperwork says one thing and my eyes say another. I'll put the kettle on for when you're back.

steps.label: come in on the last one from Emu Plains and see it
the rank at the moment the doors open

quests.title: The Door, Penrith
quests.blurb: The council knows and the council does not care. I have stood on this door near Penrith for 67 years and since a Tuesday somebody has been sending my guests to a different rank. It has been going on longer than I have admitted to anyone. Just do not come back empty-handed.

steps.label: follow one of them and see where they end up
you will be standing about, get something

quests.title: The Depot, Penrith
quests.blurb: I have been putting it off since Easter. The plates working the Penrith rank are dispatched from a depot at Emu Plains, and the man who runs it has never met a driver he liked. I have got no proof, which is exactly why I am asking. I will know if you skipped a bit.

steps.label: go and be pleasant at him anyway
tell me whether he is the problem or the symptom
